properties: Physical truth and visible-evidence support are separately represented.
Requirement support references must name evidence IDs present in that exact method condition.
All registered evidence requirements are evaluated for every condition.
Supported, contradicted, insufficient, and physically-true-but-unsupported claims remain distinct.
Highest defensible nodes are computed per diagnostic DAG and may retain independent atomic components.
Evaluator references are explicitly method_visible=false and contain no method packet export path.
The builder is canonical and byte-deterministic for identical ontology, condition bundle, and reference input.

development_fixture.result: The reference progresses from physically-true-but-unsupported command-motion diagnosis to supported discrepancy and finally a specific obstruction only after independent obstruction evidence is restored.

limitations: Requirement evaluations still need mechanism-specific independent adapters for retained land recordings.
The development fixture is not an empirical result or a sample-size contribution.
Human annotation and the maximal-supported production engine remain incomplete.
next_gate: P5 maximal-supported-diagnosis engine using only robot-visible requirement facts for production and the separately governed reference for evaluation.
